header.description: A read over a variable-width subject for tests/_helpers/test_fabricated_outputs.py: the token embeddings at the subject of each of the six known facts in facts/known, which come from the known_1000 facts of Meng et al. 2022 (arXiv:2202.05262, https://rome.baulab.info/data/dsets/known_1000.json). It is the former rome_fig1 noise-scale document, kept here because the fabricator's ragged-read cases need a table with a subject column.
